title: Preserve unknown diagonal completions using exact unary fourth-root phases
statement: For C=UKU^T symmetric, Q_C(y)=Q_K(U^T y)+2ell.y mod4 with ell_i=(Cii-Q_K(row_i U))/2 mod2. Hence(-1)^q_off(C) is the latent fourth-root phase times required unary diagonal and substitution corrections.
